  "literal": "كن جاهزًا بجسم الشاطئ هذا الصيف",

literal: كن جاهزًا بجسم الشاطئ هذا الصيف
adaptation: فورمة الساحل بتبدأ من عندنا الصيف ده
back_translation: Your Sahel shape starts with us this summer
notes: I swapped the Western 'beach body' idea, which can read as immodest or body-shaming and is especially sensitive for women in Egypt, for the local summer ritual of going to the North Coast (الساحل) and the colloquial word 'فورمة' (fitness shape), and I phrased it without a gendered imperative so it speaks to both men and women.
